reasons.detail: Jadarian Price is the only player left in RB tier 10 with a 7.9-point gap to tier 13 (Croskey-Merritt, Mason, Brooks), so this is the last chance at that tier while the TE tier 4 still has 17 players left.

Every starting slot except K and DEF is already filled (QB Hurts, RB Barkley/Javonte, WR Nacua/Pickens, TE Warren, FLEX Judkins/Flowers), so this pick is depth and the highest-value depth is a flex-capable RB in a standard-scoring, RB-heavy room.

LaPorta (105.5 proj) would only marginally beat Tyler Warren at the single TE slot and can never occupy a flex realistically, whereas Price (156 proj) is the highest-projected non-QB on the board and a plausible flex starter.

Price is 77% to survive to 92 but LaPorta is only 55.7%; however Kincaid (69%), Andrews (95.7%), Goedert (92.7%), Kittle (98.3%) and Ferguson (96.7%) mean a comparable TE is near-certain at 92, so the scarce asset is Price, not a tight end.
Team 10 owns both picks 90 and 91 and lists TE:medium with three RBs already (Jeanty, Montgomery, Corum); an RB depth grab there is entirely plausible and there is no second Price behind him.
fsGap is only 1 (fsRank 86 vs LaPorta's 85), so this is effectively on-board and Juancho's simulation rates Price's final-roster value highest at 1382.9 with dDec 0.
